756690101.text: #{NICKNAME}, over here! Paimon's got something nice to show you!

756690102.text: Lookie look! Paimon took these pictures on our travels.

756690103.text: We've been to all sorts of places, and while you were busy exploring, Paimon was busy with her Kamera!

756690104.text: Here, take a look at these photos Paimon masterfully took.

756690105.text: By the way, do you remember the two photo albums we bought at Damoville Purveyor?

756690107.text: Of course you do! Paimon spent all her savings to reserve those albums, even though it was way in advance.

756690111.text: Anywho, you took one of the albums, and Paimon took the other. That way, we'd match!

756690112.text: Paimon's already stuffed her album full of photos, but she's not sure if you've done the same yet.

756690113.text: But just in case, Paimon bought a new photo album, and although she was planning on keeping it as a backup, she'll give it to you if yours is full!

756690109.text: Eh, you don't? Paimon spent all her savings to reserve those albums, even though it was way in advance.

756690110.text: But it's fine! You're super busy all the time, so Paimon doesn't mind being a super tolerant travel companion!
